title: China 'Homegrown' Gamble: Can New 7nm Chips Finally Replace Nvidia, TSMC? - NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA), Taiwan Semiconductor (NYSE:TSM)
summary: China develops 7nm chip technology, potentially impacting Nvidia and TSMC. Beijing promotes tech self-reliance, affecting foreign tech access. Chinese firms expand AI infrastructure overseas to use Nvidia chips, amidst strong demand and supply constraints.
sentiment_reason: The article discusses China's advancement in chip technology and its implications for foreign companies like Nvidia, amidst a backdrop of geopolitical tensions and supply chain shifts, which indicates negative market impact due to potential competition and supply issues.
